text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
Mortal, set your face toward the Ammonites and prophesy against them.
text_cn: “人子，你面向阿孟子民，讲预言攻击他们，

text_en: Say to the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord God : Thus says the Lord God , Because you said, “Aha! ” over my sanctuary when it was profaned, and over the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and over the house of Judah when it went into exile;
text_cn: 向阿孟子民说：你们听吾主上主的话！吾主上主这样说：因为你讥笑我的圣殿说：‘哈哈！圣殿可受了亵渎！’对以色列地域说：‘它可荒芜了！’对犹大家族说：‘他们可被掳去了！’

text_en: therefore I am handing you over to the people of the east for a possession. They shall set their encampments among you and pitch their tents in your midst; they shall eat your fruit, and they shall drink your milk.
text_cn: 为此，看，我要将你交给东方的子民作为产业，他们要在你那里设立自己的帐幕，在那里定居，吃你的果实，喝你的奶。

text_en: I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels and Ammon a fold for flocks. Then you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 我要使辣巴成为牧放骆驼之地，使阿孟人的地方成为羊栈；如此，你们必承认我是上主。

text_en: For thus says the Lord God : Because you have clapped your hands and stamped your feet and rejoiced with all the malice within you against the land of Israel,
text_cn: 因为吾主上主这样说：因为你们对以色列地方所遭受的一切，曾手舞足蹈，满心欢喜；

text_en: therefore I have stretched out my hand against you, and will hand you over as plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples and will make you perish out of the countries; I will destroy you. Then you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 因此，看，我要伸手打击你，将你交给异族作为掠物；我要从人民中铲除你，由各国中消灭你；我要使你灭绝；如此，你必承认我是上主。”

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : Because Moab said, The house of Judah is like all the other nations,
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：“因为摩阿布【和色依尔】说：看，犹大家族与所有异民并无不同！

text_en: therefore I will lay open the flank of Moab from the towns on its frontier, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim.
text_cn: 为此，看，我要暴露摩阿布的山区，以及她边陲的城池，暴露她全国的精华，如贝特耶史摩特，巴耳默红和克黎雅塔殷。

text_en: I will give it along with Ammon to the people of the east as a possession. Thus Ammon shall be remembered no more among the nations,
text_cn: 我要将他们同阿孟子民一起交给东方的子民作为产业，使他们在异民中再不被人提及。

text_en: and I will execute judgments upon Moab. Then they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 我要向摩阿布施行惩罚：如此，他们必承认我是上主。”

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : Because Edom acted revengefully against the house of Judah and has grievously offended in taking vengeance upon them,
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：“因为厄东曾对犹大家族复仇雪耻，因对他们复仇而犯了重罪；

text_en: therefore thus says the Lord God , I will stretch out my hand against Edom, and cut off from it humans and animals, and I will make it desolate; from Teman even to Dedan they shall fall by the sword.
text_cn: 为此，吾主上主这样说：我要伸手打击厄东，将人与走兽由境内铲除，使她成为旷野，从特曼到德丹的人都要死于刀下。

text_en: I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel; and they shall act in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath; and they shall know my vengeance, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 我要藉我的百姓以色列的手替我报复厄东，他们要按我的怒气和愤恨对待厄东，如此他们便知道这是我的报复 —— 吾主上主的断语。”

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : Because with unending hostilities the Philistines acted in vengeance, and with malice of heart took revenge in destruction;
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：“因为培肋舍特人以极残忍的报复心来施行报复，为了他们的世仇，企图消灭以色列；

text_en: therefore thus says the Lord God , I will stretch out my hand against the Philistines, cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the rest of the seacoast.
text_cn: 为此吾主上主这样说：我要伸手打击培肋舍特人，铲除革勒提人，毁灭残留在海滨的人。

text_en: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful punishments. Then they shall know that I am the Lord , when I lay my vengeance on them.
text_cn: 我要在他们身上以盛怒的惩罚施行严厉的报复；当我在他们身上施行报复时，他们便承认我是上主。”
